title_en: Writing an invertible matrix as a product of elementary matrices

t.en: Recall from Algorithm “Finding the inverse of a matrix” that an $n\times n$-matrix $A$ is invertible if and only if $A$ can be carried to the $n\times n$ identity matrix using elementary row operations. Combining this with our discussion of elementary matrices we see that $A$ is invertible if and only if it can be written as a product of elementary matrices. This is the content of the following theorem.
t.zh: 回顾算法“求矩阵的逆”：$n\times n$ 矩阵 $A$ 可逆，当且仅当 $A$ 可以通过初等行变换化为 $n\times n$ 单位矩阵。把这一点与我们对初等矩阵的讨论结合起来，就得到：$A$ 可逆当且仅当它可以写成若干初等矩阵的乘积。这正是下面定理的内容。

t.en: Let $A$ be an $n \times n$-matrix. Then $A$ is invertible if and only if it can be written as a product of elementary matrices.
t.zh: 设 $A$ 是 $n \times n$ 矩阵。那么 $A$ 可逆，当且仅当它可以写成若干初等矩阵的乘积。

t.en: If $A$ is an invertible $n\times n$-matrix, then its reduced echelon form is the $n\times n$ identity matrix $I$. By Theorem “The form $R=UA$”, we can write $I=UA$, where $U = E_k\cdots E_2E_1$ is a product of elementary matrices. Then
t.zh: 如果 $A$ 是可逆的 $n\times n$ 矩阵，那么它的简化行阶梯形是 $n\times n$ 单位矩阵 $I$。由定理“$R=UA$ 的形式”，可以写出 $I=UA$，其中 $U = E_k\cdots E_2E_1$ 是若干初等矩阵的乘积。于是

t.en: By Theorem “Inverse of an elementary matrix”, if $E_i$ is an elementary matrix, then so is $E_i^{-1}$. Therefore, $A$ has been written as a product of elementary matrices. Conversely, if $A$ can be written as a product of elementary matrices, then $A$ is clearly invertible, because each elementary matrix is invertible.
t.zh: 由定理“初等矩阵的逆”，如果 $E_i$ 是初等矩阵，那么 $E_i^{-1}$ 也是初等矩阵。因此，$A$ 已经被写成了若干初等矩阵的乘积。反过来，如果 $A$ 可以写成若干初等矩阵的乘积，那么 $A$ 当然可逆，因为每个初等矩阵都可逆。

t.en: Let $A = \left[\begin{array}{rrr} 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 1 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & -2 & 1 \end{array}\right]$. Write $A$ as a product of elementary matrices.
t.zh: 设 $A = \left[\begin{array}{rrr} 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 1 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & -2 & 1 \end{array}\right]$。把 $A$ 写成若干初等矩阵的乘积。

t.en: Following the process of Theorem “Product of elementary matrices”, we first row-reduce $A$ to its reduced echelon form, recording each row operation as an elementary matrix.
t.zh: 按照定理“初等矩阵的乘积”的做法，我们先把 $A$ 行化简为它的简化行阶梯形，并把每一步行变换记为一个初等矩阵。

t.en: Notice that the reduced echelon form of $A$ is $I$. Hence $I = UA$ where $U=E_3E_2E_1$. It follows that $A = U^{-1} = E_1^{-1}E_2^{-1}E_3^{-1}$, and so we have succeeded in writing $A$ as a product of elementary matrices
t.zh: 注意，$A$ 的简化行阶梯形是 $I$。因此 $I = UA$，其中 $U=E_3E_2E_1$。由此得到 $A = U^{-1} = E_1^{-1}E_2^{-1}E_3^{-1}$，这样我们就成功地把 $A$ 写成了初等矩阵的乘积

t.en: In particular, it follows that $A$ is invertible.
t.zh: 特别地，由此可知 $A$ 是可逆的。

title_zh: 把可逆矩阵写成初等矩阵的积
